claims.statement: Backend uses pytest 8.3 + pytest-asyncio 0.24 with asyncio_mode = 'auto'. The default unit lane uses no live DB, Redis, or external services. Two auto-use fixtures isolate every test: _isolate_redis (noop Redis double) and _reset_http_singleton_registry (clears httpx singleton registry).

The selected integration lane (backend/tests/integration/) creates a unique vfic_integration_* database, migrates to Alembic head, rebinds FastAPI's real database dependency, supplies a rollback-scoped async session, and drops after the session. Missing PostgreSQL/pgvector fails setup with an actionable error — never silently skips.

Frontend uses Vitest 4 + Playwright browser mode with two projects: 'app' (headless Chromium, React/DOM unit tests, 80% coverage threshold on three-file enforced surface) and 'claude' (Node.js, Claude Code hook integration tests). Full suite currently contains 551 tests.

Playwright E2E uses a run-specific loopback database ending in _e2e, local Redis database 15, E2E-only JWT secret and admin account. Safety: ownership markers, socket guard blocks backend egress, Playwright fixture blocks browser requests outside loopback.

RAG golden-set benchmark (scripts/benchmark_rag.py) measures recall@K, precision@K, MRR against a golden dataset. The release gate (scripts/release_gate_check.py) requires a minimum pass rate before any image is pushed.

CI quality gates (quality-gates.yml): backend-unit (ruff + pytest -m 'not integration'), backend-integration (pytest -m integration against local PostgreSQL), frontend-quality (lint + typecheck + test:unit:app:coverage + build), functional-e2e (Playwright chromium + Mobile Chrome), release-gate (benchmark + release_gate_check.py).
